sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: walking (his move loop, League's walk): striding forward, the red demon blade low behind him, the white katana low before him, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: HIS TWO BLADES go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the RED DEMON BLADE and the WHITE STEEL KATANA, as long as in image 1 - each in its own hand, raised, swung, thrust or held low as the pale figure holds them; the red horned mask stays on the side of his head. Only him: no spirit flames, no wind, no slash arcs, no trails, no glow; the eye's red stays inside the eye.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his black sandal flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the hair, the arms and the blades follow the pale figure. The wide hakama swings with the legs: show each leg's shape through it, the sandals under its hems; the blades' tips hang near the ground but are NOT legs.
